findings.title: Truncated tool call parsed into invalid_tool_calls is logged as kept text
findings.problem: When max_tokens cuts a tool call mid-arguments, LangChain cannot parse the JSON, so tool_calls is empty and invalid_tool_calls is populated. is_finish_reason_tool_calls checks only tool_calls, so _finalize_truncated_text treats the message as text, finalizes it, and logs action=kept.
findings.impact: A broken tool call reports success with a misleading 'text kept' diagnostic and never reaches TokenLimitExceededException, which contradicts spec §3.3 ('tool-call truncation still raises').
findings.recommendation: In _finalize_truncated_text, when message.invalid_tool_calls is non-empty and a truncation indicator is present, finalize and then call self.agent._safe_check_for_truncation(message) so it raises like valid tool-call truncation. Add a test with invalid_tool_calls plus finish_reason=length that expects the raise.

findings.title: Forwarding max_tokens to non-Anthropic proxied models can reject long-context requests
findings.problem: The spec's blast-radius claim ('equals the proxy's existing default') holds only for Anthropic/Bedrock, where LiteLLM injects a default max_tokens. For OpenAI/Azure models LiteLLM sends no limit today, and now max_completion_tokens=max_output_tokens is always sent. Example: gpt-4o has a 128k context and 16,384 output tokens.
findings.impact: OpenAI-family providers reject requests where prompt + max_tokens exceeds the context window (context_length_exceeded), so long conversations that work today would 400. Azure OpenAI also counts max_tokens against TPM, so 429s come earlier. Native non-proxy factories already behave this way, but proxied deployments would change.
findings.recommendation: Human choice needed: (a) forward only for Claude/Anthropic-family models, where the proxy otherwise applies a 4096 fallback (smallest radius; fixes the ticket); (b) keep forwarding for all models and rely on the kill switch, documenting the risk; (c) clamp to min(max_output_tokens, max_input_tokens - estimated prompt), which is more complex. Add tests for the chosen scope.

findings.title: Supervisor truncation tests do not assert the WARNING content
findings.problem: test_supervisor_subassistant_truncation_finalizes_and_still_reports_result never checks mock_logger.warning, and test_supervisor_text_truncation_finalizes_and_warns only uses assert_called_once().
findings.impact: Spec §5 requires the supervisor paths to finalize AND warn. A format or author regression on the supervisor WARNING would go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Assert mock_logger.warning.assert_called_once_with('truncated_response model=claude-opus-5-5 indicator=<...> output_tokens=unknown action=kept') in both supervisor tests.
